summary: Hestia Insight Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Strategic Divestiture Settlement Agreement with Director Edward Lee. The board approved divesting 100% of wholly owned subsidiary Hestia Investments Inc. to settle an outstanding $500,000 compensation liability for Lee's six years of unpaid salary. Lee will remit 20% of annual subsidiary earnings for two years to the company. No cash or equity changes hands; the subsidiary's assets and debts transfer in accord and satisfaction. Advisors are not named. The transaction is a non-cash settlement/diversifying event. Watch any future earnings clawback from the retained 20% participation right.
